title: SDD docker: config namespace
description: Schema for the docker: section in .sdd/config.yaml (SPEC-0022 / CON-0072)

dockerfile.description: Path to Dockerfile relative to project root

url.description: Registry URL; empty string disables push

auth_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding registry credentials

compose_file.description: Path to docker-compose.yml; empty string disables Compose mode

enabled.description: Enable automatic log streaming after a container start via the web API (POST /api/specs/{id}/start)

max_lines.description: Maximum log lines kept in the in-memory buffer
